name.en: Sumo Squat Hold with Elbow Pry

purpose.zh: 打开髋部，拉伸大腿内侧
purpose.en: Open the hips and stretch the inner thighs.

text.zh: 双手合掌胸前，用肘把膝盖推向脚尖外
text.en: Press your palms together and use your elbows to push your knees out

text.zh: 宽站距脚尖外转，脚跟踩实
text.en: Stand wide with toes turned out and heels down.

text.zh: 胸口挺起，保持呼吸后站起
text.en: Keep your chest up, breathe, then rise.

cautions.zh: 膝盖不适时减小下蹲深度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Squat less deep if your knees feel uncomfortable, and stop if the pain continues.
